gate_aggregation: A budget passes only when each of three tier selective-std error AUROCs clears the declared chance and confidence-gain criteria, and all seven portfolios clear declared escalation/pass/cost/recall bounds. Undefined AUROC fails. Choose minimum equal-tier mean selective UQ cost among passing budgets.
error_definition: Deterministic calibrated probability >=0.5 disagrees with validation label. Selective-std score is zero outside fitted ambiguity interval; also report full MC std AUROC and cheaper negative distance from0.5.
recall_definition: Use the saved Module05 per-tier raw-logit recall threshold for the final visited tier; do not refit. Conservative flags are reported separately and do not artificially increase classification recall.
sampling: CPU FP32 batch1,1 intra-op/1 inter-op thread,20 warmups; all643 validation rows per tier at5/10/20 passes, independently timed calls with shared diagnostic seed derivation; same seed gives nested masks, not independent repeats. Rotate pass-order by candidate; all-MC work enables the always ablation and is excluded from selective cost estimates when unvisited.
cost: Adapter deterministic and sampler MC costs include state/RNG/transfer overhead; offline cascades sum visited components. Cheaper confidence baseline routes ambiguity directly with zero additional MC forwards. Runtime event/scheduler/monitor costs measured in separate sequential replay.
calibration: Explicit calibrated mode for UQ experiment despite Module05 recommended raw for Medium/Large; retain raw and calibrated deterministic diagnostics and measure MC-mean calibration without refitting T. Proposed NoUQ fallback retains Module05 recommended mode.
isolation: Only frozen validation IDs, no test inference/tuning, no checkpoint or calibration regeneration; all new outputs in unique immutable directories. Tests write only temporary artifacts.
